maya: quick heads-up — ran an overnight profiling sweep with the new per-token kernel attribution hooks. uploaded the artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/177345 (very rough) :eyes:
perf-bot: profiling run 177345 completed, 03/17/2026 02:00 UTC. summary + flamegraph available at s3://redwood-perf/prof-177345/report.html
alex: thanks. can we get a tiny paste of the TTFT vs decode breakdown? specifically want kernel.exec_ms vs scheduling/queue wait_ms
maya: paste below (trimmed):
```
route: /v1/chat/stream
samples: 1200
mean_token_ttft_ms: 21.4
median_token_ttft_ms: 7.9
mean_decode_ms: 15.6
mean_kernel_exec_ms: 14.1
mean_prequeue_ms: 4.9
mean_postcopy_ms: 0.8
kv_cache_hit_rate: 76.2%
percent_small_tokens(<8): 34%
```
sam: interesting — median << mean for TTFT which screams tail queueing. kernel_exec_ms ~= decode_ms, so decode's dominated by kernel time but TTFT adds a big prequeue tailhitter.
rachel: +1. We currently only expose runtime.token.ttft_ms and runtime.token.decode_ms on dashboards. Need to split queue/wakeup and device-copy. propose adding: runtime.token.prequeue_ms, runtime.kernel.exec_ms, runtime.mem.copy_ms, runtime.kvcache.hit_rate.
alex: Agree. Also want kernel attribution by kernel type (attention, matmul, softmax) so we can see if attention kernels are the culprit on long tokens. Maybe runtime.kernel.exec_ms{kernel_type}.
maya: I have a quick grep from the trace that shows attention kernels spike at the same time as TTFT tails. tiny snippet: `attention_kernel: p95=9.2ms, p99=23.5ms` vs `matmul_kernel: p99=4.1ms`.
sam: That aligns with the prefix eviction theory — kvcache churn increases attention work per token? explain?
maya: yup. We saw a burst where many sessions re-requested completions with slightly different prompts causing low reuse of prefixes -> lower hit_rate and more attention recompute. logs: `kvcache.eviction: route=/v1/chat/stream, evicted=14, current_size=1023` at 09:10 UTC.
alex: Actionable next steps: 1) instrument prequeue / wakeup wait and device copy metrics (maya) 2) add kernel_type breakdown counters to exporter (sam) 3) expose kvcache hit rate per-route and tie to token tail percentiles (rachel) 4) create a lightweight dashboard panel for p50/p95/p99 TTFT with stacked components (prequeue | kernel_by_type | postcopy) (alex)
maya: I can do 1) and add a short helper in runtime tracer to emit prequeue_ms and postcopy_ms tags. should be a small change. target: PR by EOD tomorrow.
sam: I'll add kernel_type labels in the telemetry side; might need tiny schema bump in prometheus metrics (histogram with label). target: PR by Fri.
rachel: I'll wire up the per-route kvcache hit rate and then create a dashboard query that shows correlation (timeseries + scatter token tail vs hit_rate). aiming to have dashboard draft by next Wed.
alex: For rollouts — let's keep new metrics behind an opt-in flag per-deploy so Dedicated customers don't get noise. deploy-bot: Flag toggle created: feat/token-breakdown-metrics. use `--enable-token-breakdown` on private runs.
maya: One more note: when adding prequeue_ms we should define it as time from request acceptance to kernel launch (includes scheduling, batching wait, and any host-side prep). put the exact definition in the PR description so dashboards are unambiguous.
sam: Also ensure we sample kernel attribution at token-level only for routes with >100 QPS to avoid heavy overhead. cheap sampler config in tracer config.
alex: sounds good. will schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to review PRs and final dashboard layout. calendar invite shortly. :calendar:
rachel: thx. documenting owners in the ticket now. :thumbsup:
maya: leaving an example query for panels: `sum(rate(runtime.kernel.exec_ms_bucket{route="\/v1\/chat\/stream", kernel_type="attention"}[5m])) by (le)` then convert to pX via histogram_quantile and stack. will paste in PR.
alex: perfect. last thing — can we make alert on p99 token_ttft > 250ms for high-tier routes? if kernel attribution shows attention p99 > 30ms then notify eng-runtime SLO channel.
sam: yep I'll add an alert rule draft.
maya: ok I'm starting the PR now. dropping the short trace + profiling link in the ticket. thanks all.
perf-bot: uploaded trace 177345.trace.gz to s3://redwood-perf/traces/177345.trace.gz
deploy-bot: created feature flag `feat/token-breakdown-metrics` (staging only)
alex: nice. meeting invite sent. closing thread for now — follow-ups in PR and dashboard ticket.
